tests.setup_dependencies: Synthetic CoreSimulator inventory JSON and real jq subprocess through JsonInspection ownership. No global environment mutation;no Simulator is booted by these tests.
tests.synchronization_timeout: Synchronous native jq execution,not pure in-memory selection. Each production jq command has a120second observation budget and3second cleanup policy;new lifecycle fixtures exercise failures with shorter injected policies.

rules.1: Select the installed usable runtime when a newer SDK has no available device.
rules.2: Native state/readiness markers are observed;no fixed sleep is treated as completion. Fixture policies use two second readiness/jq,five second build and one second cleanup budgets;the outer five second observation detects legacy non-return. Native owner polls actual state every10ms.
rules.3: N/A:no playback or media clock assertion.
rules.4: Production preparation has one synchronous owner and no boot worker thread/join. Owned native groups are retired on error/scope exit. Test FixtureWorker releases and joins on normal/unwind paths. No async-to-sync fallback.
rules.5: Fresh TempDir,atomic pid markers and invocation-specific commands/groups. No process-global PATH/env mutation,shared Simulator reset or service kill.
rules.6: Native macOS/Linux process boundary,not a simulated OS. m2 evidence only;no real xcrun/xcodebuild/Simulator or Linux execution claimed. Actual jq is required only by the original selection tests.
rules.7: Three legacy regressions were observed failing after minimal command extraction;their logs/source hashes are retained. Compile alias/lifetime and Clippy conditional-style corrections are retained. No budget or functional assertion widened to obtain a pass.
rules.8: Match stage/cause/native exit and cleanup fields. Primary operation plus peer/cleanup/capture errors remain distinct. Captured output Debug/Display expose lengths;UTF8 cause retains validation offsets without raw bytes.
rules.9: Final m2 owning suite147/147 across11nonempty targets;16zero-test CLI targets are build checks only. Fourteen selected identities each pass three exact focused runs(42/42). Source-epoch artifacts and final hashes are in .build/i371-runner-verification.json.
